text: 论文的那本摘录不知放哪里去了。
en: I don't know where that excerpt from the paper ended up.

text: 我就先查了一下相关新闻的链接。
en: I first went and checked the links to the related news.

text: 后续会做更新哈。
en: I'll add an update later, ha.

text: [表达力]
en: [Expressiveness]

text: 1 男性好多时候不是不表达，是真的不知道怎么表达。
en: 1 Men, much of the time, are not unwilling to express themselves; they simply genuinely do not know how.

text: 他们从小被教育少说多做，对表达很陌生。
en: They were brought up being told to speak little and do much, so they are quite unfamiliar with expressing themselves.

text: 2 男性比女性怕疼，女性可以通过聊天抒发，男性因为社会形象不能说疼，导致长期压力积压。
en: 2 Men are more afraid of pain than women. Women can vent through chatting, but men, because of their social image, cannot admit to being in pain, which leads to long-term stress building up.

text: 他们特别渴望一个人，能在她面前表现自己疼的样子，却又害怕对方因此看不起她。
en: They particularly long for someone before whom they can show their own pain, yet they fear that the other person will look down on them because of it.

text: 所以他们在表达感受时极其隐晦，渴望被注视感受，却往往过于隐晦被忽略。
en: So when expressing their feelings they are extremely indirect, longing to have their feelings noticed, yet often being too indirect to be noticed.

text: 3 直男夸你的时候，确实会存在损你的模式，尤其是情史很单纯的男生，他们话到嘴边就变个样子。
en: 3 When straight men compliment you, there really is a pattern of teasing you, especially with boys who have little romantic experience; the words change shape right as they reach their lips.

text: 这和小时候小男孩欺负小女孩一样，他就是想要你注意他。
en: This is just like when little boys tease little girls as children; he just wants you to notice him.

text: 他们以为男生和男生这样，和女生相处也这样。
en: They assume that because it is like this between boys, it is the same when getting along with girls.

text: 挺难改的。
en: It's quite hard to change.

text: 这也是他们的一项乐趣→_→
en: This is also one of their pleasures →_→

text: 4 男生的沉默，并不一定真的不喜欢了，也并不一定是冷暴力，有一种情况是，他不知道怎么办。
en: 4 A boy's silence does not necessarily mean he no longer likes you, nor is it necessarily cold violence; one possibility is that he simply does not know what to do.

text: 他们是会忽略感受，而拼命去想应对办法的那种人。
en: They are the type who will ignore their feelings and desperately try to think of a way to cope.

text: 你让他们表达感受，有时真的比杀了他们还难，这样的人是不在少数的。
en: Asking them to express their feelings is sometimes truly harder than killing them, and such people are not few in number.

text: “能动手的事绝不动口”吵架时男人选择沉默或动手，是因为男人的语言中枢不够发达。
en: "For anything that can be done with the hands, never use the mouth." When arguing, men choose silence or violence because men's language centres are not well developed.

text: 女性被认为拥有更为优越的语言能力。
en: Women are thought to possess superior language ability.

text: 这一点与刚才提到的语言中枢和胼胝体有密切的联系。
en: This is closely linked to the language centres and the corpus callosum mentioned earlier.

text: 最新一期西班牙《趣味》月刊载文说，研究发现，在进行与语言有关的活动时，男性只使用左脑，而女性同时使用左右脑，男性大脑负责谈话的区域面积比女性小得多。
en: The latest issue of the Spanish monthly Interesting carried an article saying that research has found that during language-related activities, men use only the left brain, while women use both the left and right brains, and the area of the male brain responsible for speech is much smaller than that of women.

text: 也就是说，男性的大脑左右半球各负责特定的工作，而女性大脑则是共同参与活动。
en: That is to say, the left and right hemispheres of the male brain each take charge of specific tasks, while the female brain participates in activities jointly.

text: 两性大脑使用上的不同，部分原因是女性连接大脑左右半球的胼胝体比男性大。
en: The difference in how the two sexes use their brains is partly because women's corpus callosum, which connects the left and right hemispheres, is larger than men's.

text: 德国有谚语说“让北海枯竭易，让女人闭嘴难”，苏格兰谚语也说“健谈男子与沉默女性同样反常”，女性多言而男性沉默看来是普遍现象。
en: A German proverb says, "Easier to drain the North Sea than to silence a woman," and a Scottish proverb also says, "A talkative man and a silent woman are equally unnatural"; it seems a universal phenomenon that women talk more while men stay silent.

text: 男人的语言能力稍弱，很容易在女人连珠炮似的言语攻击下愤怒，这种愤怒有可能表现为关闭接受系统，即沉默（也许根本没有继续听了），或者表现为暴力（只有用拳头才能让女人闭嘴）。
en: Men's language ability is somewhat weaker, and they are easily angered by women's relentless verbal attacks; this anger may manifest as switching off the receiving system, that is, silence (perhaps they have stopped listening altogether), or as violence (only fists can shut a woman up).

text: 而这些状况，往往都是被一个喋喋不休的女人逼的。
en: And these situations are often brought on by a nagging woman.

text: 【重磅】Science：男女大脑有诸多不同 Study finds some significant differences in brains of men and women
en: [Major] Science: There are many differences between male and female brains. Study finds some significant differences in brains of men and women

text: 5 男性说女性[你想多了]时，他们的确不能理解为什么会这样。
en: 5 When men tell women [You're overthinking it], they genuinely cannot understand why it is like this.

text: 如果女性想告诉你伴侣你有什么思考，请通过理性的事例陈述，以及尽可能不要延迟时间和对方去聊，因为他真的跳脱出那个情景后，就很难理解女性的话。
en: If a woman wants to tell her partner what she is thinking, please do so through a reasoned account of examples, and talk to him as soon as possible, because once he has truly stepped out of that situation, it becomes hard for him to understand what the woman is saying.

text: 女性大脑中与情绪和焦虑有关的部位、前额叶皮层和脑部边缘区域更活跃；而在男性大脑中，主管视觉和协调的部位更为活跃。
en: The parts of the female brain related to emotion and anxiety, the prefrontal cortex and the limbic regions, are more active; whereas in the male brain, the areas governing vision and coordination are more active.

text: 根据单光子发射计算机断层扫描仪的测量显示，受试者在休息和完成认知任务时，不同脑区的血流量也不同。
en: Measurements from single-photon emission computed tomography scanners show that the blood flow in different brain regions also differs when subjects are resting and when completing cognitive tasks.

text: 生活中，女人为什么往往比男人更容易感到沮丧？
en: In daily life, why do women tend to feel more depressed than men?

text: 研究人员认为，这并不是因为女人受到的压力比男人大，也不是因为其他生活方式等因素起作用，而是男女大脑中分泌的内容物有所不同，而且大脑对这些物质的反映也不一样。
en: Researchers believe this is not because women are under greater stress than men, nor because other lifestyle factors play a role, but because the substances secreted in male and female brains differ, and the brain's response to these substances also differs.

text: 有研究揭示，男女两性的大脑内容物同样存在着差异，而且这种差异十分突出。
en: Some research reveals that differences also exist in the contents of male and female brains, and that this difference is very pronounced.

text: 一个令人吃惊的结论：女性的大脑中的灰质竟然要比男性多出15%，而灰质主管着人类的思维。
en: A surprising conclusion: women's brains actually contain 15% more grey matter than men's, and grey matter governs human thought.

text: [消费观，思维差异等]
en: [Attitudes to consumption, differences in thinking, etc.]

text: 1 好多男生不是抠，而是被穷养惯了，养成了对金钱节约的习惯。
en: 1 Many boys are not stingy, but have simply grown used to being raised frugally, and have developed a habit of saving money.

text: 他们的钱的很大一部分，要拿来攒首付。
en: A large part of their money has to go towards saving for a deposit.

text: 有句话叫做，富养20年，芙蓉出水；穷养20载，宝剑出炉。
en: There is a saying: nurture richly for twenty years and a lotus emerges from the water; nurture frugally for twenty years and a sword is forged.

text: 又有句话叫做，从来富贵多淑女，自古纨绔少伟男。
en: Another saying goes: throughout history, the wealthy have reared many gentle ladies, while since ancient times few pampered wastrels have become great men.

text: 富养的女儿不贪小利，气质非凡；生活的磨砺让穷养的儿子意志更坚强；男孩子以后要走上社会，承担社会责任与家庭责任，所以要穷养以励其志，否则大手大脚，纨绔子弟一个，如何上奉父母，下养妻儿！
en: A richly raised daughter does not covet small gains and has exceptional bearing; the trials of life make a poorly raised son's will stronger; a boy must later enter society and shoulder social and family responsibilities, so he should be raised frugally to strengthen his ambition, otherwise, spending lavishly and becoming a mere pampered wastrel, how could he support his parents above and his wife and children below!

text: 富养的女孩，从小会被带着出入各种场合，增加阅世能力，等到花般年纪，再到尘世里艰难成长，便不易被各种浮华和虚荣所迷惑，一个没见过大世面的女孩，在纨绔子弟的糖衣炮弹下，很可能被花言巧语所击败。
en: A richly raised girl is taken to various occasions from a young age, building her worldly experience; when she reaches a flower-like age and then grows up struggling in the mortal world, she is less easily confused by all manner of vanity and hollow splendour; a girl who has not seen the wider world may well be defeated by sweet words under the sugar-coated bullets of pampered wastrels.

text: 富养的女孩，因为见识多，独立，有主见，明智，很清楚自己真正追求的东西。
en: A richly raised girl, because she has seen much, is independent, has her own opinions, is sensible, and clearly knows what she truly pursues.

text: （穷养儿富养女_百度百科）
en: (Raise sons frugally and daughters richly _ Baidu Baike)

text: 这才是男女消费观区别的根本原因，知道了这一点，才能更好地进行协调。
en: This is the fundamental reason for the difference in consumption attitudes between men and women; only by knowing this can one better coordinate.

text: 2 男人不是不爱做家务，有时是他真的没看到家里乱。
en: 2 Men do not dislike housework; sometimes they simply do not notice the mess at home.

text: 人体的大脑，分为拥有理论、分析、言语功能的左脑和拥有情绪、艺术、音乐感知能力的右脑。
en: The human brain is divided into the left brain, which possesses theoretical, analytical and verbal functions, and the right brain, which possesses emotional, artistic and musical perception.

text: 链接左右脑，使两者协调运作的是被叫做胼胝体的神经纤维束。
en: Linking the left and right brains and enabling them to operate in coordination is the bundle of nerve fibres called the corpus callosum.

text: 女性胼胝体的后方膨大，但是男性的却相对较小。
en: The rear of women's corpus callosum is enlarged, but men's is relatively smaller.

text: 胼胝体后部是视觉中枢所在的位置，同时也与语言中枢相连。
en: The rear of the corpus callosum is where the visual centre is located, and it is also connected to the language centre.

text: 因此，对于这部分比较发达的女性来说，大概能够更加及时的对视觉信息进行分析和处理。
en: Therefore, for women in whom this part is relatively well developed, they can probably analyse and process visual information more promptly.

text: 所以，很多时候女人抱怨“家里都乱成一团了，男人也不知道归置归置”“自己出差几天，家里就变成了猪圈”“油瓶子倒了都不知道扶；垃圾袋不放在门口就不知道扔”，你家是不是也有一个这样的男人？
en: So, much of the time women complain, "The house is a total mess and the man still won't tidy up," "I go away on a business trip for a few days and the house turns into a pigsty," "He won't even pick up an oil bottle that's fallen over; he won't take out the rubbish unless the bag is put right by the door"—does your home also have such a man?

text: 真的是因为懒才不去做的吗？
en: Is it really because of laziness that they don't do it?

text: 有时候真的是女人错怪男人了，男人眼里没活，往往不是故意偷懒，而是真的没看到乱，或者根本不觉得家里已经乱得无处下脚了。
en: Sometimes women really do wrong the men; when a man has no eye for chores, it is often not deliberate laziness, but that he genuinely does not see the mess, or simply does not feel the house is so chaotic that there is nowhere to step.

text: 建议：明确清晰的告诉男人，该做什么，或者做个家务分工计划，男人对量化具体的表格还是能看懂的。
en: Suggestion: tell the man clearly and explicitly what to do, or make a housework division plan; men can still understand quantified, concrete tables.

text: 3 关于男人的大男子主义
en: 3 On men's male chauvinism

text: 女性左右脑之间连接多，因其更需处理社会关系；男性半球内连接强，因其需捕猎与决斗。
en: Women have more connections between the left and right brains because they need more to handle social relations; men have stronger connections within each hemisphere because they needed to hunt and duel.

text: 连接方式不同，由此决定的行为方式也就不同。
en: The mode of connection differs, and thus the resulting behaviour also differs.

text: 举例来说，心理学界早就发现，男性和女性在支配行为方面有重大差异。
en: For example, the field of psychology discovered long ago that there are major differences between men and women in dominant behaviour.

text: 男性的支配行为更多表现为自我中心式的支配行为，喜欢唯我独尊，一意孤行；相比之下，女性更多表现为亲社会的支配行为，强调多尊重他人的意见，促进整个群体的利益。
en: Men's dominant behaviour is more often expressed as egocentric domination, favouring self-centred supremacy and acting wilfully; by contrast, women's is more often expressed as prosocial dominant behaviour, emphasising respect for others' opinions and advancing the interests of the whole group.

text: 建议：生活中，请理解和接纳男人有一些大男子主意，以及他们格外的好面子，因为这是他们的脑结构所决定，女人难以通过外力去改变。
en: Suggestion: in life, please understand and accept that men have some male chauvinism and an exceptional concern for face, because this is determined by their brain structure and is hard for women to change through external force.

text: 【重磅】Science：男女大脑有诸多不同
en: [Major] Science: There are many differences between male and female brains

text: 4 风险厌恶的实验测量结果，已证明男女行为存在系统性差异。
en: 4 Experimental measurements of risk aversion have shown that there are systematic differences in the behaviour of men and women.

text: Eckel C C, Grossman P J. Men, women and risk aversion: Experimental evidence[J]. Handbook of experimental economics results, 2008, 1: 1061-1073.
en: Eckel C C, Grossman P J. Men, women and risk aversion: Experimental evidence[J]. Handbook of experimental economics results, 2008, 1: 1061-1073.

text: [审美 择偶 性关注等]
en: [Aesthetics, mate selection, sexual attention, etc.]

text: 1 男性看美女就像女生看帅哥一样正常，他们也会看帅哥，但是因为普遍直男审美，他们觉得说哪个男的好看是很丢人的事。
en: 1 Men looking at beautiful women is as normal as girls looking at handsome men; they also look at handsome men, but because of the prevailing straight-male aesthetic, they find it shameful to say which man is good-looking.

text: 2 男生要舒压时，对于很大部分人群，打游戏，抽烟，看a片的确都有是最常见的办法。
en: 2 When boys want to relieve stress, for a large portion of them, playing games, smoking and watching porn are indeed the most common methods.

text: 跟女生聊八卦，吃零食，看韩剧差不多。
en: It is much the same as girls chatting gossip, eating snacks and watching Korean dramas.

text: 3 男性对面子以及性能力的重视是女生无法想象的。
en: 3 Men's regard for face and sexual ability is beyond what girls can imagine.

text: 这是生理构造和长期父系生殖崇拜的文化传统造就的，和他们“死要面子”没关系。
en: This is shaped by physiological structure and the cultural tradition of long-standing patriarchal reproductive worship, and has nothing to do with their "dying to save face."

text: 男性生殖器崇拜阶段是弗洛伊德发展阶段理论中最复杂和争议最大的阶段。
en: The phallic stage is the most complex and most disputed stage in Freud's theory of developmental stages.

text: 这个阶段决定了我们今后对异性的顺应。
en: This stage determines our later adaptation to the opposite sex.

text: 男性生殖器崇拜阶段是俄狄浦斯冲突与厄勒克特拉冲突的发生阶段。
en: The phallic stage is the stage in which the Oedipus conflict and the Electra conflict arise.

text: 这两种冲突的解决方法对成年期生活产生深刻的影响。
en: The resolution of these two conflicts has a profound influence on adult life.

text: 阳具崇拜是由弗洛伊德提出的一种心理状态假定。
en: Phallus worship is a hypothetical psychological state proposed by Freud.

text: 弗洛伊德认为由于男女生理构造的差别，女孩很容易对男孩的强壮以及各种生理状况产生妒忌，于是产生了试图成为男孩的性别困扰——就构成了所谓的阳具崇拜。
en: Freud believed that, owing to the physiological differences between the sexes, girls easily become envious of boys' strength and various physical conditions, and thus develop a gender confusion that tries to become a boy—which constitutes the so-called phallus worship.

text: 之所以产生这样的心理状态，是因为社会的构成中，时常造成了女孩的无力感。
en: The reason such a psychological state arises is that the structure of society often creates a sense of powerlessness in girls.

text: 在这里，也有一个反面观点。
en: Here, there is also an opposing view.

text: 霍妮则在之后的一篇论文中提到当男孩发现自己没有怀孕生育的本能时，他们反而会产生妒忌及自卑，所以男孩表现出的进取心，争取成功是对这种自卑感的补偿。
en: Horney, in a later paper, mentions that when boys discover they lack the instinct to become pregnant and give birth, they instead develop envy and inferiority, so the initiative and drive for success that boys display is compensation for this sense of inferiority.

text: 男性儿童体验俄狄蒲斯情结，是以索福克勒斯创作的名为〈暴君〉的古典悲剧为其名称的。
en: The Oedipus complex experienced by male children takes its name from the classical tragedy titled "The Tyrant" created by Sophocles.

text: 在整个悲剧中，俄狄斯国王杀父娶母。
en: Throughout the tragedy, King Oedipus kills his father and marries his mother.

text: 根据弗洛伊德的理论，男女两性儿童对母亲产生的强烈的积极情感，因为她满足儿童的需要。
en: According to Freud's theory, both boy and girl children develop strong positive feelings towards their mother because she satisfies the child's needs.

text: 同样男女儿童对父亲表示憎恨，因为他被看作是获得母亲关怀和慈爱的敌手。
en: Likewise, boy and girl children show hatred towards their father because he is seen as a rival for the mother's care and affection.

text: 男孩牢固地维系这些情感，而对于女孩却有所变化。
en: The boy firmly maintains these feelings, whereas they change somewhat for the girl.

text: 男孩开始俱怕作为权威敌手的父亲，这种恐惧形成了阉割焦虑。
en: The boy begins to fear the father as an authoritative rival, and this fear forms castration anxiety.

text: 也就是说，男孩产生了丧失性器官的恐惧，因为性器官被认为应对造成他与父亲之间的冲突负有责任。
en: That is to say, the boy develops a fear of losing his sexual organs, because the sexual organs are held responsible for the conflict between him and his father.

text: 这种焦虑产生了对母亲性欲冲动的替代性满足。
en: This anxiety produces a substitute satisfaction of the sexual impulse towards the mother.

text: 在某种意义上来说，男孩成了父亲，因而分享了母亲。
en: In a sense, the boy becomes the father and thereby shares the mother.

text: 这就描绘了弗洛伊德称之为恋母情结的健康解决的情形。
en: This depicts the healthy resolution of what Freud calls the Oedipus complex.

text: 这个男孩成人后大概会追求一个具有母亲多种特征的女性，也许他会唱道“我想取一个同亲爱的老父亲结婚的那样的姑娘”。
en: As an adult, this boy will probably pursue a woman with many of his mother's traits; perhaps he would sing, "I want to marry a girl like the one my dear old father married."

text: 男性生殖器崇拜阶段_百度百科
en: Phallic stage _ Baidu Baike

text: 4 不少男生的性启蒙从幼儿园就开始了。
en: 4 Quite a few boys' sexual awakening begins as early as kindergarten.

text: 5 男性需要的女性模式，往往是“后方安定”我才能“前方打仗”好。
en: 5 The kind of woman men need is often one who keeps "the rear stable" so that he can "fight at the front" well.

text: 这是远古时期的男性打猎女性捡野果模式形成的大脑机制中的一部分意识。
en: This is part of the consciousness formed by the brain mechanisms of the ancient pattern in which men hunted and women gathered wild fruit.

text: 男性进入社会后，注意力是在竞争上，而不是女人身上。
en: After men enter society, their attention is on competition, not on women.

text: 这的确是很正常的一件事。
en: This is indeed a very normal thing.

text: 以上的内容，有一些书籍，一些论文的记忆，一些来自和直男的探讨，加上我带过好几个弟弟假期在一块玩，陪他们走过青春期，所以形成了自己的一些想法。
en: The above draws on memories of some books and some papers, some discussions with straight men, plus the fact that I looked after several younger brothers during holidays, playing with them and accompanying them through puberty, which formed some of my own ideas.

text: 另外，我本科是读传媒的，女生居多，到了我读研的一段时期，是在计算机学院，周围可以说全是直男了。
en: Also, I read media studies for my undergraduate degree, where girls were the majority; during my postgraduate period I was in the computer science school, where practically everyone around was a straight man.

text: 那时真是惊异啊！
en: It was truly astonishing back then!

text: 怎么相处思维差别这么大！
en: How can the difference in how we get along and think be so huge!

text: 在国外学过一段时期的生理心理学，选的是男女大脑色彩辨别方向的课题学习，因为要读一些背景知识，除了书籍和论文，加上自己也开始恋爱了，我呢，又属于不怎么会调情那种，怕自己无聊把男票作没了，所以顺便把各门各派的进化心理学呀，pua学呀，ayawawa呀，都会有一些涉猎。
en: I studied physiological psychology abroad for a period, choosing a topic on colour discrimination in male and female brains; because I had to read background knowledge, beyond books and papers, and since I had also started dating, and I am the type who is not very good at flirting, afraid of driving my boyfriend away with my boredom, I also dabbled in various schools of evolutionary psychology, PUA, ayawawa and the like.

text: 这些毕竟是实用派的，笑。
en: These are, after all, of the pragmatic school, ha.

text: 各门学派，无论是官方的，民间的，都有可取之处，咱们也只是列出来做探讨，觉得不对的地方，欢迎大家留言。
en: All schools of thought, whether official or folk, have their merits; we simply list them for discussion, and welcome everyone to leave comments where you think something is wrong.

text: 不过别喷我啊，谢谢。
en: But please don't flame me, thanks.

text: 咱们知乎er绅士这么多，想必对我作为妹子这么一条无所事事的摘录加总结也不会太粗暴，嘿嘿嘿。
en: With so many gentlemen among us Zhihuers, I imagine you won't be too rough on a girl like me for this idle excerpt and summary, hehehe.

text: INNA：在爱情中，男生一定要做服软的那一方么？
en: INNA: In love, must the boy always be the one to yield?

text: INNA：你听到过哪些让人潸然泪下的路人对话？
en: INNA: What chance conversations among strangers have you heard that bring tears to your eyes?

text: INNA：男人真实的一面是什么样的呢？
en: INNA: What is the real side of men like?

text: INNA：为什么有了男朋友还会觉得其他男生更好？
en: INNA: Why, even with a boyfriend, do you still feel other boys are better?
